audit_items.proof_trace: The split is enforced at L175-176: `protocol_seize_amount = liq_revenue_factor.int_mul(redeem_collateral_amount)` and `liquidator_seize_amount = redeem_collateral_amount - protocol_seize_amount`. `int_mul` uses floor division (WAD-scaled), so `protocol_seize ≈ liq_revenue_factor * collateral` within 1 unit — standard fixed-point behavior. The sum invariant `protocol + liquidator = collateral_seized` holds exactly; `liq_revenue_factor` is admin-set and validated ≤ 1 (basis points / 10000), preventing underflow.
